newsitem.title: USA: Ultra Shield in sales agreement.
newsitem.headline: Ultra Shield in sales agreement.

text.p: Ultra Shield Products International Inc said Monday it has a national sales agreement with a marketer and distributor of food service products that it expects will lead to annual sales to franchised stores in excess of $17 million.

Under terms of the agreement, the company will distribute and represent Ultra Shield products nationwide to 260,000 restaurants, hotels, schools, hospitals, retirement homes and other food service operations, it said.

The new agreement coupled with existing distribution agreements that provide Ultra Shield's cleaning, degreasing, dishwashing and sanitizing products, has led it to revise its 1997 sales projections $17 million.
Its total sales for 1996 were not immediately available.
